details.description: Grok Build 0.1 is the coding model behind xAI's Grok Build agent (an interactive TUI, a headless/scripted mode, and Agent Client Protocol integrations for IDEs and other tools), and is also reachable via the API under the aliases grok-code-fast-1, grok-code-fast, and grok-code-fast-1-0825. xAI first released it in August 2025 as grok-code-fast-1, a coding model trained from scratch on a programming-heavy pre-training corpus and post-trained on real-world pull requests and coding tasks, built to use tools like grep, terminal, and file editing. It has a 256K-token context window, accepts text and image input with text output, and supports function calling, structured outputs, and reasoning.
advantages: Scored 70.8% on the full SWE-Bench-Verified subset using xAI's own internal evaluation harness (xAI grok-code-fast-1 launch post).
Versatile across the software development stack, with particular strength in TypeScript, Python, Java, Rust, C++, and Go (xAI grok-code-fast-1 launch post).
Built to use common agentic coding tools such as grep, terminal, and file editing (xAI grok-code-fast-1 launch post).
256K-token context window with function calling, structured outputs, and reasoning support (xAI model registry, docs.x.ai).
disadvantages: Accepts only text and image input with text output; no audio or video support.
The 70.8% SWE-Bench-Verified figure was measured with xAI's own internal harness rather than the standard public evaluation setup.
use_cases: Agentic coding through the Grok Build CLI/TUI, headless scripts, or Agent Client Protocol (ACP) integrations
IDE and coding-tool integrations via Grok Build/ACP
Zero-to-one project scaffolding and codebase question-answering
Targeted bug fixes and everyday software-engineering tasks

notes: xAI's docs (docs.x.ai) list this model under the name grok-build-0.1 with aliases grok-code-fast-1, grok-code-fast, and grok-code-fast-1-0825, and its client-side model registry gives a 256,000-token max prompt length and text+image input / text output, matching the catalog facts. The original grok-code-fast-1 launch post (Aug 2025) noted a multimodal, longer-context variant was 'already in training'; the current grok-build-0.1 entry (text+image in) appears to be that successor. xAI's docs/blog currently brand the company 'SpaceXAI' in page titles and body copy as of Sept 2026; I kept maker as 'xAI' for consistency with the catalog's provider id ('xai').
